# LearnTrack — Google Stitch Design Review Checklist

**Purpose:** Use this checklist to review every design generated by Google Stitch before approving it for Figma handoff and implementation.
**Reviewer:** _(fill in before review)_
**Review date:** _(fill in before review)_
**Stitch project URL:** _(fill in — do not fabricate)_

---

## How to Use This Checklist

1. Open the generated Stitch design alongside this checklist.
2. Work through each section in order.
3. Mark each item ✅ (pass), ❌ (fail), or ⚠ (needs attention / partial pass).
4. For every ❌ or ⚠, add a note explaining what is wrong.
5. A design passes review when every item is ✅ or has an approved exception recorded.
6. If any item is ❌, the design must be regenerated or manually corrected before handoff.

## Section 1 — Data Accuracy

These values are authoritative. Any deviation is a blocking failure.

| # | Check | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.1 | Course name shows exactly "AI & Python Technology Course" | | |
| 1.2 | Completed topic count shows exactly **22** | | |
| 1.3 | Not-started topic count shows exactly **19** | | |
| 1.4 | Total topic count shows exactly **41** | | |
| 1.5 | Completion percentage shows exactly **53.7%** (not 54%, not 53%, not 53.66%) | | |
| 1.6 | Circular progress ring fill corresponds to 53.7% (≈193° arc out of 360°) | | |
| 1.7 | Linear progress bar fill corresponds to 53.7% of bar width | | |
| 1.8 | Stats grid shows all three values (22, 19, 41) — none are missing or transposed | | |
| 1.9 | No fictional data has been added (no lesson names, instructors, dates, prices) | | |
| 1.10 | Status labels use only "Completed" and "Not Started" — no other status values | | |

## Notes

- **Data accuracy items (Section 1) are always blocking.** A design showing 54% completion instead of 53.7% must be corrected before any further work proceeds.
- **Section 4 (States) failures are blocking for implementation** but may be resolved in Figma during the handoff phase rather than in Stitch, provided the states are specified in the handoff document.
- Items in Sections 5–9 may be conditionally approved if the deviations are minor and documented.
- This checklist should be re-run after any regeneration or manual correction.
